summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend e2e testing of Nacho 30 RSVP landing page. All 13 backend tests PASSED (root, RSVP create yes/no, validation, admin login, list rsvps, delete). All frontend flows PASSED: hero rendering with name/30/3 pills/4 countdown cells, floating CTA appears post-scroll and smooth-scrolls to RSVP, full YES form submission with plus-one + dietary selects, NO branch with shorter form, success messages render, data persists to MongoDB and is visible in admin panel, admin login (correct + wrong password toast), stats + table render correctly, logout clears localStorage token. End-to-end integration verified: form submit → DB → admin dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: admin token is the password itself (shared secret). For a private one-off page this is acceptable, but a rotating session token would be more secure.
Minor: POST /api/rsvp returns 200; standard REST would be 201 Created. Not a bug — just convention.
Minor: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('shutdown'); migrating to lifespan handlers is recommended (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_E2E_* RSVPs were created during browser automation and were CLEANED UP via DELETE /api/admin/rsvps/{id}. The pytest test class deletes its own TEST_ entries on teardown. Admin table is now clean (0 rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://fiesta-nacho.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_nacho30_api.py — run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_nacho30_api.py -v. Shadcn Select can be opened via locator(testid).click(force=True) then page.get_by_role('option', name=...).click(force=True). Floating CTA only visible after scrollY > 40vh. All test data uses TEST_ prefix. Admin endpoint requires X-Admin-Token header (value = password).
